title: Cobblemon Interface Embossed Legacy: Modded
description: Mod Support for Embossed Legacy GUI based on Cobblemon Interface / Compatibilidad con Mods para la GUI Embossed Legacy basada en Cobblemon Interface
body:
# Cobblemon Interface Embossed Legacy: Modded ### *The expansion to bring CIEL style to your favorite mods.* **CIEL Modded** is an official extension specifically designed for **Cobblemon Interface Embossed Legacy**. Its goal is to unify the aesthetics of popular mods with CIEL's signature embossed style and color palette, ensuring your interface remains cohesive and fluid even when using third-party add-ons. --- ### 📦 Currently Supported Mods: | Mod | | :--- | | **Accessories** | | **Advancement Plaques** | | **AppleSkin** | | **Just Enough Items (JEI)** | | **LumyREI** | | **Roughly Enough Items (REI)** | --- ### ⚠️ Important Requirement: To function correctly and maintain visual consistency, this pack **must be placed above** the base [**Cobblemon Interface Embossed Legacy**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cobblemon-interface-embossed-legacy) pack in your in-game Resource Packs list. --- ### 🤝 Credits & Acknowledgments: This project is an extension based on the **CIEL** aesthetic and the original work by [**VinnyStalck**](https://modrinth.com/user/VinnyStalck). --- # Descripción en Español
Mostrar # Cobblemon Interface Embossed Legacy: Modded ### *La expansión para llevar el estilo CIEL a tus mods favoritos.* **CIEL Modded** es una extensión oficial diseñada específicamente para **Cobblemon Interface Embossed Legacy**. Su objetivo es unificar la estética de los mods más populares con el estilo de relieve (embossed) y la paleta de colores característica de CIEL, garantizando que tu interfaz sea coherente y fluida incluso cuando utilices complementos de terceros. --- ### 📦 Mods soportados actualmente: | Mod | | :--- | | **Accessories** | | **Advancement Plaques** | | **AppleSkin** | | **Just Enough Items (JEI)** | | **LumyREI** | | **Roughly Enough Items (REI)** | --- ### ⚠️ Requisito importante: Para que funcione correctamente y mantenga la coherencia visual, este paquete **debe colocarse por encima** del paquete base [**Cobblemon Interface Embossed Legacy**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cobblemon-interface-embossed-legacy) en tu lista de Resource Packs dentro del juego. --- ### 🤝 Créditos y Agradecimientos: Este proyecto es una extensión basada en la estética de **CIEL** y el trabajo original de [**VinnyStalck**](https://modrinth.com/user/VinnyStalck).
